name: Mailpost for Jira
tagline: Email an issue from Jira with templates, recipients from the issue and a send log, through Jira's own mail. Free for 10 users, then US$0.60 per user.
highlights: Email this issue, from the issue
One action in the issue menu: pick a template, add a note, choose recipients from reporter, assignee, watchers, groups, roles or user fields, and send.
HTML and plain-text templates with field placeholders and conditionals, per project, with canned responses and signatures. Escaping is enforced by the renderer.
A send log on the issue and an optional comment show who emailed what to whom. Runs on Atlassian: no mail servers, no API keys, no data leaving Atlassian.
